title: Persistent memory for the coding harness
statement: Persistent memory for the coding harness
body: Proposed. Adopt, if the owner accepts: - The model in [MEMORY-MODEL](../memory/MEMORY-MODEL.md) and the rules in [MEMORY-GOVERNANCE](../memory/MEMORY-GOVERNANCE.md), implemented by [store.cjs](../../harness/memory/store.cjs) and [memory-policy.json](../../harness/policy/memory-policy.json), operated through [memory.mjs](../../harness/scripts/memory.mjs). - Authority that code verifies: an entry is approved only through a reference to an Accepted ADR, recorded by a human or the importer. A change to an approved entry is a new entry that supersedes it under a different Accepted ADR. A hash-chained ledger and a generated architecture snapshot make edits, deletions and rollbacks detectable. - Quarantine for tool output and documents, refusal (not redaction) of sensitive data, a strict schema, and a denial log that never records refused text. - Retrieval ranked by relevance and authority, with recency only as a tie-breaker; compact summaries that never drop a pinned constraint or a conflict. - `memory/` as a control-plane path: agents cannot write it and read it only through `memory_search` (orchestrator, principal architect, architecture critic) and `memory_resume` (orchestrator). - [validate-memory.mjs](../../harness/scripts/validate-memory.mjs) in `npm run validate` and CI. - No SQLite and no vector database now, with the revisit conditions below.
subject: adr.0010
